name: agent-studio-coding-agent
description: Coding Agent plus a separate read-only Secure Agent Studio operator workbench.

commands.title: Agent Studio: Ask About Selected Code

agentStudio.model.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Deprecated and ignored by the Coding Agent. Configure the Coding Agent endpoint under agentStudio.agents.coding.baseUrl.

agentStudio.model.name.markdownDescription: Deprecated and ignored by the Coding Agent. Configure the Coding Agent model under agentStudio.agents.coding.model.

agentStudio.model.temperature.markdownDescription: Sampling temperature used for Coding Agent model requests.

agentStudio.model.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum number of output tokens requested from the model for each turn.

agentStudio.model.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Maximum duration in seconds for one model request.

agentStudio.agent.maxTurns.markdownDescription: Maximum number of autonomous reasoning/tool turns allowed for one Coding Agent task.

agentStudio.operator.repositoryRoot.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Secure Agent Studio monorepo on the Remote SSH (Node A) extension host. Leave empty when the remote VS Code workspace root is the monorepo. Read-only Operator Workbench only.

agentStudio.agents.coding.enabled.description: Enable the Coding Agent inference profile.

agentStudio.agents.coding.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for the Coding Agent. API keys are stored separately in VS Code SecretStorage.

agentStudio.agents.coding.model.description: Model identifier exposed by the Coding Agent inference endpoint.

agentStudio.agents.detector.enabled.description: Enable the Detector Agent inference profile.

agentStudio.agents.detector.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for the Detector Agent. API keys are stored separately in VS Code SecretStorage.

agentStudio.agents.detector.model.description: Model identifier exposed by the Detector Agent inference endpoint.

agentStudio.agents.evidence.enabled.description: Enable the Evidence Agent inference profile.

agentStudio.agents.evidence.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for the Evidence Agent. API keys are stored separately in VS Code SecretStorage.

agentStudio.agents.evidence.model.description: Model identifier exposed by the Evidence Agent inference endpoint.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
